2.text: “Na n'ubu kuganya kwanjye kumeze nk'ubugome,Imikoba nkubitwa isumba umuniho wanjye.

3.text: Iyaba nari nzi aho nyibona,Ndetse ngo nshyikire intebe yayo,

4.text: Nayitangirira urubanza rwanjye rwose,Akanwa kanjye nkakuzuzamo amagambo yo kwiburanira,

5.text: Nkamenya amagambo yansubiza,Kandi nkumva icyo yambwira.

6.text: Mbese yankāngāza imbaraga zayo nyinshi?Oya ahubwo yanyitaho.

7.text: Aho ni ho umukiranutsi yaburanira na yo,Incira urubanza ikantsindishiriza iteka ryose.

8.text: “Dore nigira imbere ariko ntihari,Nasubiza inyuma nkayibura.

9.text: Mu kuboko kw'ibumoso aho ikorera na ho sinyiharuzi,Yihisha mu kuboko kw'iburyo kugira ngo ntayibona.

10.text: Ariko izi inzira nyuramo,Nimara kungerageza nzavamo meze nk'izahabu.

11.text: Ikirenge cyanjye cyashikamye mu ntambwe zayo,Inzira yayo narayikomeje sinateshuka.

12.text: Ntabwo nasubiye inyuma ngo mve mu mategeko yategetse,Ndetse amagambo yo mu kanwa kayo yambereye ubutunzi,Bundutira ibyokurya binkwiriye.

13.text: “Ariko igira icyo yitumye ni nde wabasha kuyivuguruza?Kandi icyo umutima wayo ukunze ni cyo ikora.

14.text: Kuko ari yo isohoza icyo nategekewe,Ndetse ifite n'ibimeze nk'ibyo byinshi.

15.text: Ni cyo gituma nkurwa umutima n'uko ndi imbere yayo,Iyo ntekereje ndayitinya.

16.text: Imana yihebesheje umutima wanjye,N'Ishoborabyose yanteye imidugararo.

17.text: Ni ibyo bimbabaza si umwijima,Cyangwa umwijima w'icuraburindi umpfutse mu maso.
